This packet's warning def:p02-w02-p02-041-church-predecessor (handbook/parts/p02/second-and-higher-order-logic-w02-p02-041.tex lines 617-628) states the correct attribution, so the two texts now disagree on route; the 040 sentence should be aligned by its owner.
